verdict.rationale: Payroll preview via an API is a fair question for a payroll product, but the evidence pack shows no API endpoint for previewing a payroll run and no automated anomaly surfacing. The docs only describe a user manually checking the Analytics > Custom Payroll Report before running payroll. Probes found no OpenAPI spec and no llms.txt.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent run a payroll preview via the API and surface anomalies for review before I approve the run
